resources.string: Choose and configure a mode, then return to the viewfinder. The main shutter starts it; press again to save a temporal result or stop a source sequence. Changing camera settings stops capture. Set focus and exposure first. Originals are retained; RAW live accumulation and mount control are not provided.

Preview modes use bounded SDR sRGB frames, not sensor RAW. The pre-capture window, sampling rate, dimensions and memory cap are configurable; the memory cap may shorten the window. Shutter saves the latest sampled frame strictly before the press. Live ND intentionally blurs moving subjects; Composite builds light trails. Keep the phone on a tripod in both modes. Preview blending cannot recover clipped highlights or camera motion. Maximum preview session: 5 minutes.

Photo sequences preserve full captured sources; the rendered stacked JPEG is up to 2048 pixels. Astro aligns modest field rotation and may reject unsuitable frames. HDR uses confirmed auto-exposure compensation steps around your baseline and restores it afterward. Foreground/subject motion can limit results.
